structured_output.summary: Atomics.sub follows the spec. The modification function reads the element type, converts both byte lists with RawBytesToNumeric, subtracts (Number or BigInt) and converts back with NumericToRawBytes. It then delegates to the shared atomic_read_modify_write helper, which handles validation, coercion, revalidation and the buffer write. Only the one in-scope file changed. The 8 remaining test failures come from Atomics.store being unimplemented, which is a different ticket. Both unreachable! flags are justified: the helper has already validated that ta is a TypedArray, and both byte lists are converted with the same type, so x and y are always the same numeric kind.
